summary: This is a final confirmation run for an algorithm that already scored 100/100 (the maximum) in both iteration 1 and iteration 2. The algorithm builds a tree decomposition of a cactus graph (tree + leaf ring) using L/R leaf-tracking bags of size ≤ 4, satisfying all problem constraints. The sole experiment arm re-runs the unchanged solution to verify the perfect score holds.
key_points: What we're testing: Whether the L/R leaf-tracking tree decomposition algorithm continues to achieve the maximum score of 100 on the judge, confirming no regressions or environment changes.
Single arm (h-main): Submit the existing solution.cpp unchanged and run the judge script once; expected output is 'SCORE: 100'.
Confirmation criterion: Score = 100 confirms the algorithm is optimal and the campaign can close. Any score < 100 would indicate a judge environment change or a latent bug, triggering investigation.
Risk assessment: Very low — the same code scored 100 in two independent prior iterations. No new algorithmic variants are needed since we are already at the score ceiling.
Recommendation: Approve this final confirmation pass, then close the campaign if score = 100 is reproduced.
